claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean on Friday, April 10, 2026, at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II mission crew will land off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the Moon.
The astronauts of the Artemis II mission are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission landing date/time is April 10, 2026, around 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II mission landing location is the Pacific Ocean near San Diego.
